theme.en: AI Demand Tightens Memory and Access
theme.zh: AI需求收紧存储供给与算力准入

dek.en: Memory pricing and supply expectations are moving higher as AI infrastructure absorbs capacity, while Washington focuses on routes that could extend Chinese access to advanced compute. Equipment localization and rack-scale deployments show the pressure is spreading across the stack.
dek.zh: AI基础设施正在吸收更多产能，推高存储价格与紧缺预期；与此同时，美国正把监管焦点转向可能扩大中国获得先进算力的路径。设备国产化和整柜级部署表明，这一压力正蔓延至整条产业链。

title.en: AI & Accelerators
title.zh: AI与加速器

title.en: Cisco and NVIDIA expand secure AI factory to Supermicro racks
title.zh: Cisco与NVIDIA将安全AI工厂扩展至Supermicro整柜系统

summary.en: Cisco's Secure AI Factory with NVIDIA is adding integrated Supermicro rack-scale systems for larger AI clusters. The move packages networking, compute and security into a more standardized deployment path, reflecting demand for faster cluster integration rather than component-by-component assembly.
summary.zh: Cisco的Secure AI Factory with NVIDIA新增了Supermicro整柜级系统，以支持更大规模的AI集群。该方案把网络、计算和安全能力打包成更标准化的部署路径，反映出市场希望加快集群集成，而非逐一组装组件。

title.en: Foundry & Manufacturing
title.zh: 晶圆代工与制造

title.en: TSMC and U.S. researchers report SOT-MRAM work for AI
title.zh: 台积电与美国研究人员报道面向AI的SOT-MRAM研究

summary.en: A report says TSMC and U.S. scientists have developed spin-orbit-torque MRAM work aimed at AI applications. SOT-MRAM is relevant because non-volatile memory with fast switching could eventually support lower-energy data movement, although the report does not establish a commercial manufacturing timetable.
summary.zh: 报道指出，台积电与美国科学家开展了面向AI应用的自旋轨道力矩MRAM研究。SOT-MRAM之所以受到关注，是因为具备快速切换能力的非易失存储器有望降低数据搬运能耗；不过该报道并未给出商业化制造时间表。

title.en: Memory
title.zh: 存储

title.en: SK hynix CEO expects memory shortage to extend to 2030
title.zh: SK hynix CEO预计存储芯片短缺将延续至2030年

summary.en: SK hynix's CEO said the memory-chip shortage could last until 2030. That is a notably long view of AI-led tightness: it implies capacity additions may remain behind demand from high-bandwidth-memory and data-center customers for several years.
summary.zh: SK hynix首席执行官表示，存储芯片短缺可能持续到2030年。这是对AI驱动供需紧张的长期判断，意味着未来数年新增产能仍可能落后于HBM和数据中心客户带来的需求。

title.en: Mobile DRAM and NAND bundle reportedly rises 340% year on year
title.zh: 手机DRAM与NAND组合价格据报同比上涨340%

summary.en: A new estimate puts a 12GB DRAM plus 256GB NAND package at roughly $310, after a reported 340% increase from a year earlier; the bundle is said to exceed the cost of a premium smartphone SoC. If sustained, that inversion would push handset makers to revisit bill-of-materials assumptions and pricing rather than treat memory as a secondary cost line.
summary.zh: 一项最新估算称，12GB DRAM加256GB NAND的组合价格约为310美元，较去年上涨340%，并据称已超过高端智能手机SoC的成本。若这一变化延续，手机厂商将不得不重新审视物料清单与定价假设，而不能再把存储视为次要成本项。

title.en: Equipment & Materials
title.zh: 设备与材料

title.en: Axcelis–Veeco deal recasts the equipment portfolio
title.zh: Axcelis与Veeco交易重塑半导体设备组合

summary.en: Analysis of the Axcelis Technologies and Veeco combination frames the merger as a reshaping of their semiconductor-equipment exposure. Combining ion-implantation and process-equipment franchises could broaden the merged supplier's customer and technology footprint, while integration execution becomes the key variable.
summary.zh: 对Axcelis Technologies与Veeco合并的分析认为，这笔交易正在重塑双方在半导体设备领域的布局。离子注入与工艺设备业务的结合可扩大合并后供应商的客户和技术覆盖面，但整合执行将成为关键变量。

title.en: China equipment localization reaches 35%, with gaps in subsystems
title.zh: 中国半导体设备国产化率达35%，关键子系统仍有缺口

summary.en: A report puts China's semiconductor-equipment localization rate at 35%, while saying vacuum valves and RF power equipment remain about 80% foreign supplied. The figures underline that progress at the tool level does not remove dependence on specialized upstream subsystems that can constrain domestic manufacturing.
summary.zh: 一份报道称，中国半导体设备国产化率已达35%，但真空阀和射频电源等设备仍约80%依赖海外供应。该数据表明，整机层面的进展并不等于摆脱对专业上游子系统的依赖，而这些环节仍可能约束国内制造能力。

title.en: Policy & Geopolitics
title.zh: 政策与地缘政治

title.en: U.S. targets third-country cloud route for Chinese AI access
title.zh: 美国瞄准经第三国云服务获取中国AI算力的路径

summary.en: A report says the U.S. is moving to block a third-country cloud workaround that could give Chinese users access to advanced AI compute through data centers in Thailand and Singapore. The proposal would shift enforcement beyond physical-chip shipments toward the location and control of remote compute services.
summary.zh: 报道称，美国正推动封堵一条第三国云服务绕行路径，该路径可能让中国用户通过泰国和新加坡的数据中心获得先进AI算力。此举将把执法重点从实体芯片出货延伸到远程计算服务的所在地与控制权。

title.en: Challengers & Design Tools
title.zh: 新兴厂商与设计工具

title.en: Agentrys raises $24.5 million for agentic chip-design platform
title.zh: Agentrys为智能体芯片设计平台融资2,450万美元

summary.en: Agentrys has raised $24.5 million for its agentic chip-design platform and says it exceeded 90% on an NVIDIA benchmark. The financing highlights continued interest in using AI agents for design flows, but the reported benchmark result should be distinguished from production design-win and tape-out evidence.
summary.zh: Agentrys为其智能体芯片设计平台融资2,450万美元，并称在一项NVIDIA基准测试中超过90%。这笔融资显示市场仍在关注AI智能体进入设计流程，但该基准成绩应与量产设计导入和流片验证证据区分开来。

theme.en: Memory, Interconnect, and Trust Meet AI Scale
theme.zh: 存储、互连与可信计算应对AI规模化

dek.en: This week's selected papers focus on the physical and system limits of AI hardware: reliable analog memory, long-context pipelines, trusted GPUs, and secure design automation. Several results are simulation or prototype based, so their reported gains should not be read as production-level benchmarks.
dek.zh: 本周入选论文聚焦AI硬件的器件与系统瓶颈：可靠的模拟存储、长上下文流水线、可信GPU以及安全的设计自动化。其中若干结果基于仿真或原型，报告的增益不应直接视为量产级基准。

title.en: Devices & Process
title.zh: 器件与工艺

title.en: Watching a GaN transistor switch in real time
title.zh: 实时观察GaN晶体管开关过程

papers.authors: C. Corley-Wiciak, N. T. Sammler, B. Butej, et al.

summary.en: The authors use stroboscopic dark-field X-ray microscopy to image strain and heat through the switching cycle of an industrial GaN HEMT. They correlate nanoscale fields with time-dependent electrical behavior and benchmark simulations against measurements. The work offers a direct diagnostic route for transient hot spots and stress, although it is a measurement methodology rather than a new device process.
summary.zh: 作者利用频闪暗场X射线显微术，成像观测工业级GaN HEMT整个开关周期内的应变和热量变化。他们将纳米尺度场分布与时变电学行为相关联，并用测量结果校准仿真。该工作为瞬态热点和应力提供了直接诊断路径，但其核心是测量方法，而非新的器件工艺。

title.en: AI Accelerators & Compute-in-Memory
title.zh: AI加速器与存算一体

title.en: ReRAM crossbars resist update disturbance for in-memory training
title.zh: 抗更新扰动的ReRAM交叉阵列面向存内训练

papers.authors: Wooseok Choi, Tommaso Stecconi, Donato Francesco Falcone, et al.

summary.en: The work presents a 350 nm CMO/HfOx ReRAM device for analog crossbar training and targets disturbance during parallel weight updates. It reports 60 ns analog switching and endurance beyond 100,000 pulses, with simulations used to analyze disturbance tolerance. The result addresses a practical weakness in analog training arrays, but it does not yet establish a scaled accelerator system.
summary.zh: 该研究展示了用于模拟交叉阵列训练的350 nm CMO/HfOx ReRAM器件，重点解决并行权重更新时的扰动问题。作者报告60 ns模拟开关和超过10万次脉冲的耐久度，并通过仿真分析抗扰能力。该结果针对模拟训练阵列的实际短板，但尚未证明可扩展的加速器系统。

title.en: AI Systems & Inference
title.zh: AI系统与推理

title.en: Virtual pipeline parallelism for long-context LLM prefill
title.zh: 用于长上下文LLM预填充的虚拟流水并行

papers.authors: Yan Shi, Xiaochao Wang, Jingchun Gao, et al.

summary.en: VPP keeps prefill chunks fixed but uses virtual pipeline stages to overlap expensive middle stages with lighter work from neighboring chunks. On 16 Ascend 910C NPUs and sequences up to 1M tokens, the authors report up to 13.1% higher throughput than dynamic chunked pipeline parallelism. The result is relevant to long-context serving but is demonstrated on a specific vLLM-Ascend and MoE setup.
summary.zh: VPP保持预填充分块大小固定，但借助虚拟流水阶段，将较重的中间阶段与相邻分块的较轻工作重叠。在16颗Ascend 910C NPU及最长100万token序列上，作者报告相较动态分块流水并行，吞吐量最高提升13.1%。该结果适用于长上下文服务，但其验证基于特定的vLLM-Ascend和MoE配置。

title.en: Circuits, Memory & Reliability
title.zh: 电路、存储与可靠性

title.en: Blackwell confidential computing benchmarked for LLM workloads
title.zh: Blackwell机密计算在LLM工作负载上的基准测试

papers.authors: Daniyal Khan, Amean Asad, Ansgar Grunseid

summary.en: This benchmark compares confidential and non-confidential LLM inference and training on NVIDIA B200 GPUs in Intel TDX virtual machines. It reports 1–3% throughput overhead for correctly configured confidential inference, while stock stacks can incur 30–40% penalties. The study separates fixed host costs from encrypted-NVLink costs, making configuration and communication mix central to the result.
summary.zh: 该基准在Intel TDX虚拟机中，对比了NVIDIA B200 GPU上机密与非机密LLM推理和训练。作者报告，正确配置的机密推理吞吐开销为1%至3%，而默认软件栈可能带来30%至40%的损失。研究区分了固定主机开销与加密NVLink开销，因此配置方式和通信占比是结果的核心。

title.en: Revisiting Rowhammer mitigation security in deployed systems
title.zh: 重新审视已部署系统中的Rowhammer缓解安全性

summary.en: The paper analyzes Sigries, a Rowhammer mitigation deployed in Microsoft's Azure Cobalt 200 SoC, and argues its tracker-to-sampling transition is vulnerable to a round-robin attack. The authors estimate a mean time to failure of about one second under that attack and propose a filtered mitigation scheme. Its practical impact depends on implementation details and deployment assumptions.
summary.zh: 论文分析了部署在微软Azure Cobalt 200 SoC中的Sigries Rowhammer缓解机制，并认为其从跟踪模式切换到采样模式时易受轮转攻击。作者估计该攻击下的平均失效时间约为1秒，并提出过滤式缓解方案。其实际影响取决于实现细节与部署假设。

title.en: EDA & Hardware Security
title.zh: EDA与硬件安全

title.en: RTLGuard defends RTL code-generation models against poisoning
title.zh: RTLGuard防御RTL代码生成模型投毒

papers.authors: Mahshid Rezakhani, Kimia Azar, Hadi Kamali

summary.en: RTLGuard uses a small clean teacher model, feature alignment and distillation to reduce backdoor behavior in poisoned RTL code-generation models. It addresses a supply-chain concern created when chip teams rely on third-party fine-tuned models to produce synthesizable RTL. The approach avoids full retraining, but its practical value depends on trusted RTL-data coverage and the threat model.
summary.zh: RTLGuard通过小型干净教师模型、特征对齐和知识蒸馏，降低被投毒RTL代码生成模型中的后门行为。该工作针对芯片团队依赖第三方微调模型生成可综合RTL时产生的供应链风险。该方法避免了全参数重训，但实际价值取决于可信RTL数据的覆盖范围和威胁模型。
